stationCatalogProvenance: Complete JMA AMeDAS station-information history dataset mirror. Metadata must be cross-checked with original JMA amdmaster.index before approval.
selectionNotes: Use full station history, not active stations only.
Preserve each historical station configuration and discontinuity flag.
A station is only a candidate if at least one precipitation+temperature configuration overlaps 1991-2020.
Do not infer daily PRCP/TMAX/TMIN record completeness from capability flags.
